metaDescription: Secure passwordless authentication service using Passkey and Magic Link.
description: Choose your preferred secure login method
magicLinkDescription: We will email you a secure link and a code to sign in.
passkeyVerifying: Signing you in with your passkey…
toastErrorEmail: Please enter a valid email address.
toastErrorPasskey: Passkey sign-in was cancelled or unavailable.
codeDescription: We sent a sign-in link and a 6-digit code to {email}. Open the link, or enter the code here.
sendCodeDescription: We will email you a 6-digit code to sign in.
codeOnlyDescription: We sent a 6-digit code to {email}. Enter it here.
passkeyOfferDescription: Sign in to {email} with it now: this device uses it if it has it (synced passkeys included), or offers to use your phone.

register.title: Complete your profile
register.description: Pick a username to finish setting up your account. Your name and birthday are optional.
register.usernameHint: 2–30 characters: letters (accents welcome), numbers and underscores.
register.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

passkeyPrompt.title: Add a passkey
passkeyPrompt.description: Next time, sign in with your face, fingerprint or screen lock instead of waiting for an email.
passkeyPrompt.error: Could not add a passkey. You can add one later from your account.
passkeyPrompt.exists: This device already has a passkey for your account.

consent.title: Authorize {app}
consent.description: {app} wants to sign you in with your account. You can revoke access anytime from your account settings.
consent.continueDescription: You're signed in. Continue with this account, or use another one.
consent.scopePublicProfile: Your username, first name, and profile photo
consent.scopeProfile: Your name, username, birthday, and profile photo
consent.error: Something went wrong. Please try again.

verify.title: Sign in?
verify.message: Continue to sign in as {email}. If you didn't ask for this link, close this page.

handoff.title: You're signed in
handoff.message: Return to the app to continue. You can close this window, or manage your account below.

account.title: Your account
account.profileDescription: Update your username and personal details.
account.unsavedDescription: Your profile has changes you haven't saved yet.
account.photoError: Could not update your profile photo.
account.photoInvalid: That file couldn't be read as an image.
account.passkeysDescription: Sign in faster with Touch ID, Face ID, or a security key.
account.passkeysHint: Add a passkey to sign in without a magic link.
account.noPasskeys: You haven't added any passkeys yet.
account.passkeyExists: This device already has a passkey for your account.
account.appsDescription: Apps you've allowed to sign you in.
account.sessionsDescription: Devices currently signed in to your account.

admin.title: Admin
admin.secretWarning: Copy this now — it won't be shown again.
admin.regenerateConfirm: Generate a new secret? The old one stops working.
admin.deleteConfirm: Delete this app? This cannot be undone.
admin.formHomeUrlHint: Optional. Linked as “Back to app” when users open their account from this app (?client_id=…). Must share an origin with a redirect URI.
admin.formBackchannelLogoutHint: Optional. When a sign-in that gave this app tokens ends, a logout token is POSTed here so the app ends its session at once (OIDC Back-Channel Logout). Must be reachable from this server.
admin.formRolesHint: Comma-separated role names for this app.
admin.formDefaultRolesHint: Auto-assigned to each new member on link (must be valid roles).
admin.formTrustedHint: Skip the consent screen for this app.
admin.formConfidentialHint: Issues a client secret (for server-side apps).

emails.signInLinkIntro: Click the button below to sign in. This link is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once.
emails.signInLinkTextIntro: Click to sign in (valid for 15 minutes):
emails.signInOrCode: Or enter this code on the sign-in page:
emails.signInCodeIntro: Enter this code on the sign-in page. It is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once.
emails.ignoreNote: If you didn't request this, you can ignore this email.
emails.passkeyAddedSubject: A passkey was added to your account
emails.passkeyRemovedSubject: A passkey was removed from your account
emails.passkeyAddedIfNotYou: If this wasn't you, remove it from your account page and sign out of the sessions you don't recognise.
emails.passkeyRemovedIfNotYou: If this wasn't you, sign out of the sessions you don't recognise on your account page.
emails.identityCodeSubject: Your code to confirm it's you: {code}
emails.identityCodeIntro: Enter this code to confirm it's you. It is valid for 15 minutes.
emails.newEmailCodeSubject: Your code to confirm your new email: {code}
emails.newEmailCodeIntro: Enter this code to confirm this is your new email address. It is valid for 15 minutes.
emails.emailChangedBody: Your account's email address is now {email}. Sign-in codes and links go there from now on.
emails.emailChangedIfNotYou: If this wasn't you, sign in with your passkey right away and change it back.
emails.signInCodeForAppSubject: Your code to sign in to {app}: {code}
emails.signInCodeForAppIntro: Enter this code on the sign-in page to sign in to {app}. It is valid for 15 minutes and can be used once.
emails.deletionScheduledSubject: Your account will be deleted on {date}
emails.deletionScheduledBody: You asked to delete your account: it will be deleted with everything in it on {date}, and you've been signed out everywhere.
emails.deletionScheduledKeep: Changed your mind? Sign in before then and nothing is lost.
emails.deletionCancelledBody: You signed in, so your account's deletion is cancelled. Nothing was lost.
emails.newDeviceBody: Your account was just signed in to from {device}.
emails.newDeviceBodyForApp: Your account was just signed in to from {device}, to use {app}.
emails.newDeviceIfNotYou: If this wasn't you, end that sign-in from your account page and remove any passkey you don't recognise.

emailChange.title: Change your email
emailChange.description: Confirm it's you, then confirm your new address.
emailChange.sendNewCode: Send a code to this address

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.description: Your account is deleted 30 days after you confirm, with its passkeys, sign-ins and links to apps. Signing in again before then keeps it.
deleteAccount.finalBody: You'll be signed out everywhere now, and your apps lose their sign-in. Signing in within 30 days cancels the deletion.
deleteAccount.scheduledBody: It will be deleted on {date}. Sign in before then to keep it.
deleteAccount.sectionDescription: Deleted 30 days after you confirm; signing in before then keeps it.
